title: Nvidia’s Valuations Show AI Rally Isn’t a Bubble, DBS Says
key_facts: DBS Group CIO Hou Wey Fook spoke in a Bloomberg TV interview
Nvidia trades at 17 times 12-month forward earnings, per Bloomberg data
Hou compared this with Cisco at 100 times before the dot-com crash
Nvidia is projected to have 70% earnings growth next year
Hou advocates a "barbell" mix of tech stocks with investment-grade bonds, hedge funds and gold
quote_evidence: "If I describe the poster child of AI trading at mid-teens, how can it be a bubble?" he said.
why_it_matters_hint: A valuation argument against the bubble view, from one bank.
notes: Bloomberg article (Bloomberg Automation credited) read on Yahoo Finance; source credited to Bloomberg, not the copy site. The article gives "projected 70% earnings growth for next year" for Nvidia.
